label: E2: equal-weight ensemble of the five round-2 entries

compute.notes: No training of its own: members are tab_gbm_b2, flowcast_v1, seq_lstm_b2, seq_tcn_b2, seq_ssm_b2 (registered). Dev + sim-val evaluation 11 CPU-min.

feature_engineering: None of its own: each member reads the batch as registered. Combination per target day, weights 1/5: mean of the members' means; each quantile = mean of the members' same quantile, then sorted.
compare_note: ens_e1 is the pre-registered comparator; seq_lstm_b2 is E2's best member on dev (0.4386), recorded before the exam
rule: PREREG section 5: registered if dev median NSE >= 0.95 x the best member's dev median NSE; 'ensembling helps on dev' only if > best member + 0.01

rungs.change: equal-weight mean of tab_gbm_b2, flowcast_v1, seq_lstm_b2, seq_tcn_b2, seq_ssm_b2 (quantile averaging)
rungs.why: dev 0.454 >= 0.95 x 0.439 (best member seq_lstm_b2): gate passes. +0.015 over the best member: by the pre-registered rule ensembling helps on dev, though the paired bootstrap against that member is a tie (-0.013..+0.037). E2 vs E1 on dev +0.009 (tie, -0.013..+0.073).
